Definition: to pour out, i.e. (figuratively) smelt, utter
BiblicalUsage: tsûwq is the word for to pour out, to smelt. In Job 28:2, brass is molten out of the stone, and it appears again in Isaiah 26:16.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the smelting of Job and the pouring out of Isaiah both picture a refining I cannot do myself.
